name: Balancing Staff
effect: +8 to Move Stat Rolls.

name: Dancing Dagger
effect: +1 damage; doesn't use a dagger-carrying soldier's item slot.

name: Demonic Vessel
effect: Activated (action) to mark a spot; a demon activating/moving within 3" rolls Will TN14 or is imprisoned (killed for scenario purposes), consuming the vessel.

name: Devouring Skull Ring
effect: No self-damage from successfully casting Spelleater.

name: Falconeye Mask
effect: +1 damage on bow/crossbow/javelin attacks; -3 Combat Roll vs. shooting attacks.

name: Firefairy
effect: One-use: destroys an enemy's scroll (and its attempted spell) in line of sight.

name: Living Quill
effect: Casting Furious Quill may instead animate it as an Animated Skull-statted Construct; once/game; risk of destruction if reduced to 0 Health.

name: Magic Dog Whistle
effect: Lets an apprentice/wizard activate a warhound/wolf within 12" without line of sight/range limits; or lets a soldier group-activate with one.

name: Misticene Quiver
effect: Bow/crossbow attacks count as magic; a natural 1 empties it for the game.

name: Obliteration Orb
effect: Once/game, cast Destructive Sphere while in combat; natural 1 destroys the orb and hits the caster with +5 elemental. May be affixed to a staff for 300gc (no item slot; staff destroyed if orb is).

name: Planebreaker Hammer
effect: +1 damage (hand or two-handed, chosen on find); +1 Fight vs. demons; damaging a demon forces a Will TN6 (penalized by damage dealt) or it's banished (auto-success at Will+10).

name: Ring of Foresight
effect: Spellcaster only; once/scenario, +8 to an Initiative Roll (comparison only, not trigger effects).

name: Ring of Recall
effect: Action (even in combat) to leave the table safely with any carried treasure dropped in place; 16+ on a die destroys it after use.

name: Ring Sabre
effect: +1 Fight hand weapon with a ring socket, letting the wielder carry a 2nd copy of that ring type.

name: Shield of the Paladin
effect: +2 Will resisting/breaking spells; regains 1 Health whenever targeted by a non-shooting spell.

name: Shielding Pendant
effect: Lets Elemental Shield be cast on the wearer despite being "Self Only," within 12"/LoS of the caster.

name: Spitfire Wand
effect: Spellcaster-only +1 elemental shooting attack at 16"; also grants Elemental Resistance (1).

name: Staff of Radiance
effect: +1 damage; Destroy Undead can hit 2 adjacent undead instead of one.

name: The Grimoire of Fin Dalka
effect: A ciphered tome of all 8 Fire Giant spells. Deciphering one costs 100gc + a Will Roll (TN20): success learns it normally; failure grants a cumulative +1 to future attempts on that spell; a natural 1 permanently locks it for that wizard. Sells for 1,000gc minus 100gc per spell already learned from it.

name: Two-Headed Wand
effect: Casts Transpose between two figures in LoS of the caster and within 16" of each other.

name: Winged Bracelet
effect: An Imp gained from Summon Demon also gains Flying.

name: Apotropaic Charm
effect: Immune to Curse spells.

name: Bloodfeast Sword
effect: +1 Fight/+1 Will (hand or two-handed, fixed on find); -2 Will (cumulative) each time it kills.

name: Book of the Construct
effect: Teaches Animate Construct to build one specific pre-modified bestiary construct type (rolled on a sub-table: Blade-Dog, Glass Man, Candle-Jack, Demonic Prison, Construct of Burden); no size penalty.

name: Construct Battery
effect: 6 power points spendable on any Animate Construct casting, like empowering with Health; non-renewable.

name: Construct Key
effect: Spellcaster-only; +4 to Control Construct within 4".

name: Construct Patch (2)
effect: Action to heal an adjacent friendly construct up to 6 Health; comes as 2 uses.

name: Endless Tea Flask
effect: Action to heal 1 + grant +2 Will until next activation; once per activation.

name: Hammer Talisman
effect: Lets Elemental Hammer target an unarmed construct.

name: Heartsapper
effect: All constructs within 3" suffer -1 Move/Fight/Will, -2 melee damage (non-stacking).

name: Invisibility Cloak
effect: Once/game, free-action Invisibility on self, auto-cancelled next activation.

name: Jumping Beans (5)
effect: Free-action bean grants a jump-based move (halved carrying treasure); no fall damage if it reaches the ground; unusable by constructs/undead/animals/demons.

name: Necklace of Protection
effect: Once/game, action to create Circle of Protection; 1–7 cancels it each subsequent turn (no roll turn one).

name: Orb of Mystic Fire
effect: Once/game, throw 8" as a +3 elemental attack, leaving a Magical Fire token at impact.

name: Quiver of Free Will
effect: Damaging a controlled (temporary) figure cancels the control spell on it.

name: Scattershot Comb
effect: One-use Scattershot effect for a non-spellcaster.

name: Staff of Turmoil
effect: Spellcaster: +1 Casting Roll at the cost of -1 Will (cumulative) and 1 damage on a failed cast; stops working once Will is negative.

name: Sword of Power (1)
effect: +1 damage hand weapon carrying 1 power point.

name: Thundershaker
effect: Once/game: activates -1 to all missile attacks for the rest of the game (non-stacking with Call Storm), then optionally +1 elemental shooting at 8" (natural 1 backfires for 5/8 damage).

name: Treasure Cloak
effect: Once/scenario: secures a carried treasure token at the table edge while the wearer stays on table.

name: Wallbreaker
effect: Once/game: walks straight through and removes a Wall spell.

name: Amulet of Constancy
effect: Immune to Decaying Touch/Time Decay/Decay spell; +1 vs Petrify & Slow; costs the wearer experience.

name: Amulet of the Stone Heart
effect: Never Wounded, immune to poison, but cannot cast; -1 survival roll at 0 Health.

name: Arrow of Demon Slaying
effect: +5 elemental damage to demons on hit.

name: Arrow of Piercing
effect: Single shot hits up to 3 figures in a line.

name: Blade of Feasting
effect: +2 Fight vs demons; +1 to next Summon Demon roll after damaging one. (Carries Tiszirain's True Name.)

name: Crossbow of Force
effect: Any hit pushes the target back 1".

name: Executioner's Blade
effect: Extra action on a natural 20 attack roll.

name: Giant Slayer Blade
effect: +2 Fight vs Large creatures.

name: Golem Flesh
effect: Permanently +1 Move/Fight/Armour to a construct (one use).

name: Magic Ammunition (roll)
effect: One-use arrow/bolt: Wraith Arrow, Arrow of Demon Slaying, Stunning Arrow, Arrow of Piercing, or Soulseeker Arrow.

name: Null Blade
effect: On damage, cancels ongoing spell effects on the target.

name: Piercing Stiletto
effect: Treats non-Large opponents as Armour 10 (dagger only, no off-hand).

name: Ring of Focus
effect: Spend all actions in an activation for +1 Casting Roll.

name: Ring of Restoration
effect: +2 Health if the spellcaster doesn't cast that activation.

name: Ring of Transference
effect: Transfer own Health to a warband member within 6".

name: Robes of Faith
effect: Once/game, Armour becomes 10+Will vs one hit.

name: Shroud of Foresight
effect: Natural 20 for initiative grants an extra action (max 3).

name: Silver Star Pendant
effect: +2 Health on a natural 20 Casting Roll.

name: Smoke Bomb
effect: One-use 3" smoke cloud blocking line of sight.

name: Soul Shield Pendant
effect: Discard to survive at 1 Health instead of 0; -40 XP.

name: Soulseeker Arrow
effect: Target rolls Will instead of Fight; treats Armour>12 as 12.

name: Spell Shield
effect: +3 to the initial Will roll resisting a spell.

name: Stunning Arrow
effect: Will TN20 or lose next activation.

name: Trapmaster Gloves
effect: +3 vs Trap Numbers.

name: True Name
effect: Fragment of a major demon's life-force; used to Forge a Pact.

name: Vampiric Staff
effect: +2 to next Casting Roll after damaging a foe in melee.

name: Wraith Arrow
effect: Ignores terrain penalty & target's cover bonus.

name: Armour of Elemental Absorption
effect: Ignores first 3 damage from elemental attacks.

name: Armour of Righteousness
effect: Thaumaturge-only; +2 Armour but blocks Necromancer/Elementalist/Summoner spells.

name: Bear Armour
effect: Bear-only; +2 Armour, -1 Move.

name: Book of the Beastcrafter
effect: Required in the vault to brew the Elixir of the Beastcrafter.

name: Book of the Bone Binder
effect: Raise Zombie (Out of Game) creates a permanent undead outside the normal warband limit.

name: Bottle of Time
effect: One-use; grants two extra actions this activation.

name: Circlet of the Time Walker
effect: Extra action when Time Walk is cast (risk: destroyed on a 1–2).

name: Flute of Fleeting Images
effect: +1 to cast Illusionary Soldier (vault item, no need to carry).

name: Gloves of Runecasting
effect: Explosive Rune can be placed within 3" and LoS instead of on self.

name: Iron Collar
effect: Warhound/wolf companion only; +2 Fight, +2 Armour, +1 Will.

name: Mirror of Foresight
effect: Lets Awareness be attempted Out of Game before a game.

name: Scroll of Nightmare
effect: Contains the extinct Spiritualist spell Nightmare.

name: Seeing Stone
effect: Awareness grants +3 initiative instead of +1 while worn.

name: Spectral Blade
effect: Treats non-magic-armoured foes as Armour 10.

name: Staff of Defence
effect: -2 damage modifier to enemy melee attacks.

name: Thunderstrike Javelin
effect: Javelineer-only; once/game +3 Shoot or +3 Fight javelin attack.

name: Wand of Mending
effect: Lets Heal be cast as a 12" Line of Sight spell.

name: Amulet of Repelling
effect: Once/game, In Combat: action forces a Will Roll TN18 on one opponent or they're pushed back 1"; wearer exits combat.

name: Arrow of Crumbling
effect: Targets a spot; Shoot Roll TN10. Success treats the terrain as hit by Crumble.

name: Arrow of Force
effect: On a hit (damage or not), target is moved 10" directly away; stops at terrain over ½" tall.

name: Arrow of Undead Slaying
effect: Any damage against an undead creature instantly reduces it to 0 Health.

name: Blessed Charms
effect: Worn on antlers, no item slot; +1 Fight vs. demons and can harm demons immune to non-magic weapons.

name: Crystal Pendant
effect: Wearer can see invisible creatures.

name: Deafening Crossbow
effect: On firing, all within 6" of the shooter (not the shooter) make a Will Roll TN13 or take 2 damage.

name: Dreadstone of the Fallen Mind
effect: Wizard/apprentice only; opposed Will Rolls vs. a target — win and the target can't approach the bearer for the rest of the game.

name: Earthquake Staff
effect: Once/game action: +3 attack to everyone within 8"; anyone within 4" that's damaged is also knocked down.

name: Explosive Arrow
effect: Targets a spot; Shoot Roll TN10. Success treats the spot as a successful Grenade.

name: Giantsbane Weapon
effect: Hand weapon; +3 Fight vs. giants.

name: Giantslayer Weapon
effect: Two-handed weapon; +6 damage vs. frost giants.

name: Ice Staff
effect: Wizard/apprentice only; action creates a 3"-diameter ice circle that punishes movement in/out with a Move Roll or 2 damage.

name: Iron Cauldron
effect: +1 to a shaman's Casting Roll when casting Fire Spice.

name: Life Ward
effect: Wearer is immune to Strike Dead.

name: Potion of Regeneration
effect: 200gc. Bought and used in contact with a Healing Well: revives a fallen warband member, placed adjacent, inactive that turn, with a permanent -2 Health penalty (cumulative). Still counts as "dead" for the post-game survival roll, but that roll may be rerolled once (must keep the second result).

name: Quiver of Giant Hunter Arrows
effect: +3 Shoot vs. frost giant targets.

name: Quiver of the Huntress
effect: Holds up to ten magic arrows plus unlimited mundane ones; counts as a single item.

name: Superior Flint Weapons
effect: Bonus as normal, but only shatter on a natural 1 if the opponent also rolled 16+.

name: Talisman of Will
effect: Treat as a Ring of Will.

name: Wand of Fireballs
effect: Spellcaster only; casts Elemental Bolt (CV5) ignoring giant elemental resistance. Useless after 5 uses.

name: Wandering Stones
effect: Paired items; once/game, swap places with the other stone's bearer (treasure carriers teleport randomly instead).

name: Webcaster Arrow
effect: On a hit, wraps target in sticky goo — next activation needs a Fight Roll TN18 or it gets no actions.

name: Amulet of the Ghoul King
effect: Scenario-unique; +1 Will, +2 casting Control Undead on ghouls, Raise Zombie can produce a ghoul instead.

name: Book of Bones
effect: Raise Zombie produces a skeleton instead (armoured for +30gc Out of Game).

name: Book of the Rangifer
effect: Lets a wizard field a rangifer as a soldier (100gc) — but it will leave if any undead join the warband.

name: Boots of Leaping
effect: Action to leap up to full available movement, ignoring rough terrain; no fall-damage exemption on landing.

name: Club of Battering
effect: Two-handed; +1 Fight, push-back on a win becomes 3".

name: Crystal Rose
effect: Re-roll a survival roll once (must keep the second result), then is destroyed.

name: Dark Cauldron
effect: Base item; +1 to Create Zombie and Revenant casts Out of Game.

name: Eyes of Amoto
effect: Paired amulets; once/game, a spellcaster can draw LoS through the other wearer.

name: Fire Heart Gemstone
effect: Scenario-unique; transfers up to 3 damage/hit onto the gem (destroyed at 5+ transferred in one game).

name: Grimoire of the Homunculus / Lichdom / Revenant
effect: Teaches the matching spell; can't be purchased, only found. A Grimoire of Lichdom can be destroyed for +50 XP instead.

name: Horn of Hellfire
effect: Once/game, +5 magic shooting attack at 24"/LoS.

name: Ivory Scroll
effect: Random spell scroll, reusable each game unless a 19–20 breaks it.

name: Magic Spectacles
effect: See and target Invisible figures; destroyed if the wearer rolls Lost Eye.

name: Quiver of the Soul Seeker
effect: Bow/crossbow attacks count as magic.

name: Ring of Life
effect: +1 Fight/+1 Armour vs. undead; melee attacks vs. undead count as magic.

name: Scarf of Obscurance
effect: +1 Fight rolls made to resist shooting attacks.

name: Sword of Undead Slaying
effect: +3 Fight vs. undead; counts as a magic weapon.

name: Unbreakable Orb
effect: Free activation-time shield: untouchable and unable to act until next activation; works even mid-combat.

name: Vampire Blade
effect: No Fight/damage bonus, but heals 2 Health whenever it damages a living foe.

name: Vial of Starlight
effect: 10 charges to empower Thaumaturge spells, including Out of Game.

name: Wraithbottle
effect: Thrown 10"; releases a wraith on impact (one-use).

name: Book of the Construct
effect: Lets a wizard cast Enchant Weapon on a construct as if it were a carried weapon (not embeddable). Vault-storable.

name: Construct Hammer
effect: Fits a medium/large construct after a successful Animate Construct; the construct counts as wielding a magic two-handed weapon. One per construct.

name: Construct Oil
effect: Applied after a successful Animate Construct for a permanent +1 Move; 3 applications per barrel, one per construct.

name: Mind Wrench
effect: +1 to cast Control Construct.

name: Script of the Golem
effect: Every successful Animate Construct produces a construct with +2 Health. Vault-storable, wizard-only.

name: Scroll of Shape Starfire Elemental
effect: Contains the lost Astromancer spell above. 300gc.

name: The Book of Null
effect: After each game, roll a die: on a 1 the wizard temporarily forgets a random known spell for the next game; otherwise +10 experience. Only one copy possible; never tradeable.

name: Truestroke Chisel
effect: +1 to cast Animate Construct; vault-storable; max +1 regardless of copies owned.

name: Amulet of True Paths
effect: Tunnel Fighter treats a 17–18 initiative roll as 19 for secret passages.

name: Arrow Magnet
effect: Free action; -4 to all non-magic shooting attacks until next activation.

name: Backpack of Hefty Haulage
effect: Pack mule only; +1 Move/Fight, +2 Armour, no item slot cost.

name: Bearclaw Pendant
effect: Tracker only; +2 Fight/+2 Shoot vs animals.

name: Belt of Blade-breaking
effect: 12+ on a die destroys the enemy's melee weapon on a hit taken.

name: Black Pipe
effect: Spellcaster only; -1 Will, +1 Fight vs shooting while smoking.

name: Bladed Staff of Fire
effect: Monk only; +2 extra damage on the bladed staff.

name: Bloodstone Amulet
effect: +1 Health; 15+ save on reaching 0 Health or it's destroyed.

name: Book of Charity
effect: Thaumaturge caster; +5 XP for donating 20gc pre-game (exclusive w/ Book of Murders).

name: Book of Murders
effect: Necromancer caster; start at -1 Health for +5 XP (exclusive w/ Book of Charity).

name: Book of the Pentangle
effect: Lost Magic scroll Casting Roll treated as 13, not 12; +10gc selling such scrolls.

name: Boots of Standfirm
effect: Once/game, ignore a push-back or Push spell.

name: Bracers of True Flight
effect: Javelineer only; +1 Fight/Shoot/Move.

name: Construct Crossbow
effect: Construct upgrade (not an item); one +2/24" shooting attack per game.

name: Construct Varnish
effect: One-use; permanent Elemental Resistance 2 for a construct.

name: Eye of Malcor
effect: Cures the Lost Eye injury, +1 Shoot, but -1 Health per game.

name: Firehelm
effect: Mail-capable figure; +1 Health.

name: Flicker Stone
effect: Once/game, force combat on anyone moving within 3".

name: Gem Hammer
effect: Carried by a thief who survives the game; +20gc for the warband.

name: Gloves of the Paladin
effect: Hand weapon counts as magic vs weapon-immune creatures.

name: Gondola Repair Shop
effect: Base resource (500gc); repairs 5 damage to an owned sky gondola per game.

name: Invisible Wire
effect: Trap Expert treats a 2–4 initiative roll as 1 for springing traps.

name: Karmic Belt
effect: Mystic Warrior only; +1 Move.

name: Leash Arrow
effect: On hit, Fight TN18 or pulled 8" toward the shooter.

name: Lycanthrope Serum
effect: Drinker becomes a werewolf for the game (can't hold treasure/items); reverts after.

name: Mind Lock Ring
effect: Immune to Mind Control (not undead/demons).

name: Miracle Stone
effect: Natural 20 on a damage roll: stone absorbs it all, then breaks.

name: Partially Gnawed Grimoire
effect: Roll 4x on Random Spell Table and choose — risk of destruction/injury on duplicate rolls.

name: Porter Control Rod
effect: Lets a controlled Collegium Porter join the warband after a game.

name: Potion Bag
effect: One item slot holds two potions.

name: Ring Chain
effect: Wear two magic rings instead of one (blocks wearing an amulet).

name: Ring of Fog Form
effect: Once/game, ignore terrain and can't be forced into combat for the rest of the activation.

name: Sandalwood Brace
effect: Negates the Smashed Leg permanent injury (and its penalty if already held).

name: Scroll Case
effect: One item slot holds two scrolls.

name: Sickle of the Crowmaster
effect: Crow master only; +1 Fight hand weapon (bypasses the no-items rule).

name: Sky Gondola
effect: Full vehicle; see Core Rule Updates above.

name: Tatakaka (bird/feather)
effect: Vault creature; feathers grant +1 to an Out of Game Casting Roll.

name: Timelash Ring
effect: Once/game auto-cast Whiplash; 1-in-20 chance the ring explodes (Lost Fingers injury).

name: Tookroot (x5 doses)
effect: Negates Will penalties from the Psychological Scars injury.

name: Troll Shackles
effect: Captures a troll dropped to 0 Health as a future warband soldier.

name: Wand of Casting
effect: 10 points of power to empower one random spell (max 2/casting).

name: Wand of Lost Magic
effect: Functions as a Scroll of Lost Magic, reusable 3 times.

name: Bane Weapon
effect: Hand or two-handed weapon that does double damage to one randomly determined creature type (wraiths, vampires, frost giants, giant worms, snow trolls, or werewolves); a plain magic weapon vs. everything else.

name: Barbarian's Blade
effect: Two-handed, +1 Fight; if fighting alone (no allies within 8"), also +1 Armour, +2 Will, +1 damage.

name: Book of the Werewolf
effect: Hire a single werewolf as a soldier (200gc, 100gc with a Beastcrafter trait); needs 20gc/game upkeep or it leaves; carries no items.

name: Circlet of the Serpent
effect: Will TN14 to shrug off being poisoned (can be poisoned again later).

name: Dancing Blade
effect: +1 Fight; enemies only get +1 per supporting figure against the wielder instead of +2.

name: Glitter Gloves
effect: Action to apply a Glow-spell effect to a figure within 4".

name: Ground Manaworm Teeth
effect: One-use; ingest to instantly dispel all spells currently active on you.

name: Horned Helmet
effect: -1 Will; charge-and-attack in the same activation to fight with +2 Fight (magic) instead of your weapon, at the cost of +2 damage taken if you lose.

name: Magic Staff Ring
effect: Makes any staff count as a magic weapon in melee; staff+ring still only one item slot.

name: Mindstone (4)
effect: An Orb of Power usable only for Soothsayer spells; rechargeable via an Orb Plinth.

name: Nimblewalk Boots
effect: +4 to Move Rolls against a Target Number.

name: Orb Plinth
effect: Vault item; recharges a low-charge Orb of Power between games (1-in-20 chance it cracks, most rolls do nothing, better rolls add 1 charge).

name: Potion of Persistence
effect: Free action on hitting 0 Health: stay in play for 3 more turns (or until damaged again) before finally going down.

name: Rat Flute
effect: Action; all giant rats in LoS Will TN16 or lose their next activation (natural 20 instead enrages one rat to charge the piper).

name: Reaver's Sword
effect: Unique, scenario-found; +2 damage, +1 Move while wearing mail (cap 7). Can't be bought, sells for 250gc.

name: Ring of Command
effect: Wizard/apprentice only; once/game, activate an extra soldier within 12" alongside your own activation.

name: Spellcatcher Glove
effect: Will TN20 (or 22 if the target was within 2") to "catch" an incoming spell-shooting-attack and negate it; once/game.

name: Sword of Wounding and Healing
effect: +1 damage; action to drink its built-in potion for up to 2 Health, rechargeable between games by sacrificing a healing potion.

name: Tyco's Magic Block
effect: One-use; instantly conjures a Wall-spell wall in contact with the figure that activated it.

name: Vampiric Crossbow
effect: Sacrifice 2 Health to empower a shot into a magic attack for +1 extra damage (+3 total over base).

name: Whitestar Diamond
effect: One-use; treat any Will roll as the minimum needed to succeed (or as a 16 with no Target Number), then it's destroyed.

name: Animal Mind Leash
effect: Winning a fight vs. an uncontrolled animal (Fight/Will <+5) lets it join the warband temporarily; once/game.

name: Animal Whistle
effect: Action: animals within 12" roll Will TN16 or flee 6" (natural 20 charges instead + immunity for the game); once/turn.

name: Bag of Snacks
effect: Counts as having consumed 1sp automatically after every game.

name: Beartooth Talisman
effect: Spellcaster-only: +2 to Control Animal, controls 2 animals at once.

name: Beastslayer Blade
effect: +1 Fight/+2 damage vs. animals (hand or two-handed); animals always attack it in multi-combat; +1 to random-encounter rolls while its carrier is present at a token pickup.

name: Book of Charts
effect: +4 to the roll for first pick of deployment edge.

name: Construct Cook
effect: Construct modification: +10sp transport capacity, +2sp post-game; no modification penalty under Fireheart rules.

name: Demonic Talisman
effect: Spellcaster-only: +2 to Control Demon, controls 2 demons at once.

name: Elemental Bear Trap
effect: Placed token; contact = +6 elemental attack (flying/levitating immune); returns to owner post-game.

name: Elemental Whip
effect: Magic hand weapon; 2" shooting attack capped at 5 elemental damage, uncapped in melee.

name: Gleaming Trident
effect: Hand or two-handed; +2 damage vs. animals; grants Amphibious.

name: Glitter Dust
effect: Free-action 1" dust cloud blocking LoS; inside it, +10 Fight vs. shooting; dissipates next activation.

name: Golden Mead
effect: Whole-warband +1 Will for the game if consumed pre-game; costs everyone 1sp.

name: Golden Wings
effect: Once/game free action: Flying for the rest of the turn.

name: Heartseeker Bow
effect: Bow or crossbow (fixed on find); +1 damage vs. animals.

name: Heartshield Amulet
effect: On a suffered critical hit: 11+ negates the damage and destroys the amulet.

name: Horn Quiver
effect: No move + a shot = automatically poisoned; or spend an action to coat the next shot.

name: Ice Axe
effect: +1 damage magic hand weapon; +3 to all terrain-effect rolls.

name: Locket of Broken Promises
effect: Once/game: auto-pass a required Will Roll; 1–5 destroys it after use.

name: Magical Rope Ladder
effect: Carrier gets Expert Climber; or place it as a free action for anyone to climb.

name: Mystically-honed Armour
effect: +4 Will resisting/overcoming spells.

name: Parrying Dagger
effect: -1 melee damage taken, if not also carrying a two-hander/staff/shield.

name: Polished Shield
effect: +2 Fight vs. shooting; negates an opponent's Latch On.

name: Potion Bandolier
effect: 2 extra potions fit in 1 item slot.

name: Quiver of the Wind Goddess
effect: Ignores wind shooting penalties (incl. Call Storm); once/game, declare one shot magical.

name: Ring of Stoneskin
effect: Not with heavy armour; +1 Armour + Rock-hard Skin.

name: Sealskin Armour
effect: Light Armour + Amphibious.

name: Snake Staff
effect: +1 Fight; all its attacks are poisoned.

name: Spiced Arrows
effect: -2 damage but marks the target so uncontrolled animals within 12"/LoS preferentially attack it.

name: Stinkweed Extract (4)
effect: Applied figure is ignored by uncontrolled animals (-1 Fight/retreat if forced to fight anyway); 4 doses/slot.

name: Talisman of Undead
effect: Spellcaster-only: +2 to Control Undead, controls 2 undead at once.

name: Teleportation Collar
effect: Worn by an animal companion; wizard may teleport adjacent to it once/game (with treasure).

name: Toughened Armour/Robes
effect: +1 starting Health (lost first, unrecoverable in-game); robes are caster/unarmoured-only.

name: True Sight Arrow
effect: +1 Shoot/+2 damage; can target invisible figures in LoS; recovered after the game.

name: Utility Boots
effect: No rough-ground penalty; +4 to all terrain-effect rolls.

name: Warming Blade
effect: Hand/two-handed/staff (fixed); +1 damage; immune to hypothermia and cold-related Will Rolls.

name: Staff of Power (1)
effect: Item of Power: a pool of 1 point that can empower a Casting Roll or Will Roll instead of spending the caster's own Health. Recharges between games.

name: Staff of Power (2)
effect: Item of Power: a pool of 2 points that can empower a Casting Roll or Will Roll instead of spending the caster's own Health. Recharges between games.

name: Staff of Power (3)
effect: Item of Power: a pool of 3 points that can empower a Casting Roll or Will Roll instead of spending the caster's own Health. Recharges between games.

name: Ring of Power (1)
effect: Item of Power: a pool of 1 point that can empower a Casting Roll or Will Roll instead of spending the caster's own Health. Recharges between games.

name: Orb of Power (6)
effect: Item of Power: a one-time pool of 6 points that can empower a Casting Roll or Will Roll instead of spending the caster's own Health. Does not recharge — once drained it's empty and can't be sold.

name: Wand of Power (1)
effect: Item of Power: a pool of 1 point that can empower a Casting Roll or Will Roll instead of spending the caster's own Health. Recharges between games.

name: Staff of Casting
effect: Roll on the Random Spell Table to identify a spell when found; grants +1 to the Casting Roll for that specific spell.

name: Boots of Speed
effect: +1 Move.

name: Ring of Slow Fall
effect: Immune to falling damage, regardless of the distance fallen.

name: Ring of Will
effect: +1 Will.

name: Ring of Teleportation
effect: Once per game, spend an action to teleport up to 8" anywhere in line of sight (not off the table); cannot be used to move into or out of combat.

name: Gloves of Strength
effect: +1 damage modifier on all successful hand-to-hand attacks.

name: Robes of Arrow Turning
effect: +4 Armour against bow and crossbow attacks.

name: Amulet of Resistance
effect: Once per game, add +4 to a Will Roll to resist a spell; may be used after the die is rolled.

name: Gloves of Casting
effect: Once per game, a spellcaster gains +5 to one Casting Roll; must be declared before the roll is made.

name: Wand of Light
effect: Once per game, roll two dice when attempting to cast a spell and choose which result to use.

name: Horn of Destruction
effect: Once per game, spend an action to blow the horn; treat as a successfully cast Crumble spell.

name: Fate Stone
effect: Once per game, re-roll any one Casting Roll, Stat Roll, Combat Roll, or Shooting Roll.

name: Construct Hammer
effect: Fits a medium/large construct before or after a game; the construct counts as carrying a magic weapon with an additional +1 damage modifier. One per construct.

name: Amulet of Elemental Energy Absorption
effect: Negates 1 elemental damage per hit; once/game, absorb all damage from one source instead (17+ roll fails and it explodes for +3 extra damage).

name: Armring of Strength
effect: +5 to all Fight Stat Rolls (not combat rolls).

name: Blood Beetle
effect: Wearer is immune to poison.

name: Book of the Foulhorn
effect: Hire a Foulhorn specialist soldier (200gc); risk of it injuring a random warband member (-3 Health) before each game on a 16+.

name: Book of Wisdom
effect: Wizard may count one Monk or Mystic Warrior as a standard soldier instead of a specialist.

name: Bottle Imp
effect: Smash (action) to release an uncontrolled Imp adjacent; single use.

name: Bracelet of Vigour
effect: +8 to Health Stat Rolls; wounded threshold becomes 2 Health instead of half.

name: Bronze Star of the Apprentice
effect: Spellcaster never takes more than 1 damage from a failed Casting Roll.

name: Burning Icon
effect: +2 to the Will-roll effect of a Casting Roll when casting Banish.

name: Cloak of Tattered Shadows
effect: +2 Fight vs. shooting attacks.

name: Dazzling Cape
effect: Once/game, move while in combat without triggering forced combat from current opponents.

name: Enchanted Scroll Wax (6 uses)
effect: Seals a written scroll so its Casting Number becomes 15 instead of 14.

name: Enchanted Teetotum
effect: Once/game, force a reroll of any randomly-determined direction.

name: Enchanted Vials (6 uses)
effect: Sealed potion has a chance (19-20) not to be consumed on use.

name: Extended Scroll
effect: Bridge spell creates a 9" bridge instead of 6" and lasts longer (vanishes only on a roll of 1); one use.

name: Feather Blade
effect: Magic two-handed sword that takes only 1 item slot instead of 2.

name: Golden Fangs (6 uses)
effect: Used with Animate Skull for +1 Fight; up to 6 fit in one item slot.

name: Golden Incunabula
effect: Apprentice suffers only -1 (not -2) Casting Roll penalty for an associated spell.

name: Gutter Flail
effect: Two-handed flail; free attack action when moving into combat.

name: Hypnotic Puppet
effect: -2 to target's Will Roll vs. Mind Control/Suggestion cast within 8"; risk of self-damage on a natural 1.

name: Ice-Crystal Pin
effect: Grants Elemental Resistance (1).

name: Icon of the Sun
effect: +1 damage vs. undead in melee; immune to Energy Drain doubling.

name: Ivory Hand
effect: Push spell attack becomes +11 (from +10), plus 3 extra damage if the push stops the target early. Can be grafted onto a staff (500gc).

name: Lantern of Holy Light
effect: Free action to unshutter: acts as Glow plus a mobile Circle of Protection, forcing undead/demons within 3" to flee; risk of going out.

name: Lifelong Plant
effect: Vault item; pluck a leaf post-game for +1 to one warband member's survival roll; the plant can die on a 21 roll.

name: Lightning Brooch
effect: Elemental Resistance (2); incompatible with heavy armour or other Elemental Resistance sources.

name: Mantle of the Bear (or Leopard)
effect: The matching Animal Companion counts as a standard soldier instead of a specialist.

name: Mask of Many Faces
effect: Attackers get only +1 (not +2) per supporting figure when ganging up on the wearer.

name: Mind Lock Collar
effect: Animal-only item; grants the Mind Lock creature trait; blocks other items.

name: Mindguard Shield
effect: +4 Will on all rolls to resist or break spells.

name: Potion Drinker Staff
effect: +1 damage staff; can be pre-loaded with a sacrificed potion's effect, usable once as an action.

name: Quiver of the Hunter
effect: Carries up to 4 magic ammo pieces without using item slots.

name: Ring of Elemental Fire
effect: A Wall spell wall does 2 elemental damage to anyone touching or activating in contact with it.

name: Slippery Boots
effect: Push-back after winning combat extends to 3", usable even in a tied combat.

name: Sticky Finger Gloves
effect: Bonus/extra rolls for claiming unclaimed treasure at game end; one wearer's benefit per warband per game.

name: Surefoot Boots
effect: +5 to Move Stat Rolls.

name: Talisman of Speed
effect: Once/game, "Run For It" move up to 6" instead of 3".

name: Amulet of Charisma
effect: Artefact (unlock: post-game Will Roll TN18). Recruit one extra specialist; wearer suffers -1 Will.

name: Circlet of Defence
effect: Artefact (unlock: post-game Will Roll TN22). Wizard is immune to one chosen spell forever (and can no longer cast it); starts each game at -2 Health.

name: Creature Mask
effect: Artefact (unlock: post-game Will Roll TN16). Uncontrolled creatures fighting the spellcaster attack the next-highest-Health target instead; cumulative -1 Will each trigger.

name: Gloves of the Worm Rider
effect: Artefact (unlock: post-game Will Roll TN20). Giant worms ignore the wearer; can summon a giant worm once/game; risk of death by worms on a natural 1 survival roll.

name: Golden Bottle of Yens
effect: Artefact (unlock: post-game Will Roll TN16). Used with Brew Potion to create 2 doses; drinking requires a Will Roll or the drinker is poisoned instead of gaining the effect.

name: Mask of Death
effect: Artefact (unlock: post-game Will Roll TN14). Wearer counts as undead (with both bonuses and penalties); loses the normal +1 survival-roll bonus.

name: Mystic Shears
effect: Artefact (unlock: post-game Will Roll TN18). Cut a specialist's hair pre-game for +2 to one Casting Roll; risk of -1 Health to that specialist (permanent on a 20).

name: Pulsing Gem
effect: Artefact (unlock: post-game Will Roll TN18). Item of Power (4) usable only for Blink; lets Blink move 6" and reroll direction; cumulative -1 Fight vs. shooting per use.

name: Ring of Destiny
effect: Artefact (unlock: post-game Will Roll TN20). +20 XP after the game (can exceed the 300 cap); -1 to survival roll if reduced to 0 Health.

name: Ring of Levitation
effect: Artefact (unlock: post-game Will Roll TN16). Grants the Levitate creature trait; wearer suffers -3 Will.

name: Scroll Shield
effect: Artefact (unlock: post-game Will Roll TN14). A random spell appears on the shield pre-game; a nearby spellcaster can cast it like a scroll; wearer starts each game having already taken 1 damage.

name: Skull Staff
effect: Artefact (unlock: post-game Will Roll TN16). +1 Casting Roll for Animate Skull/Raise Zombie; can maintain two skulls/zombies at once (they gain Strong); -2 Casting Roll if more than one is on the table.

name: Soulchill Blade
effect: Artefact (unlock: post-game Will Roll TN12). On a combat win, treat the opponent's Armour as 9+Will; damaged figures get -1 Fight for the rest of the game; wielder loses -1 Will per kill.

name: Staff of the Illusionist
effect: Artefact (unlock: post-game Will Roll TN18). Fool's Gold token moves 6" instead of 4"; wizard may maintain two illusionary soldiers; -2 Will while both are active.

name: Sword of Elemental Fire
effect: Artefact (unlock: post-game Will Roll TN16). Builds "Elemental Energy" from Elementalist spells, adding to hit damage (max 5, resets each hit/game); a natural 1 in melee causes self-damage and resets it.

name: Sword of Woe
effect: Artefact (unlock: post-game Will Roll TN18). +2 Fight, +1 Will; losing a fight causes 2 extra damage; a natural 1 while receiving support damages a random ally for 10.

name: Tiger Eye Ring
effect: Artefact (unlock: post-game Will Roll TN20). Extends line of sight 2" past any visible point (wizard only), moving the Wizard Eye further; risk of 3 damage on a failed Will Roll each use.

name: Vampire Staff
effect: Artefact (unlock: post-game Will Roll TN18). Empowers Casting/Will Rolls using a nearby warband member's Health (3 Health = +1, max +4); a damaged donor permanently leaves the warband (or becomes uncontrolled if a creature).

name: Wand of Brilliant Power (3)
effect: Artefact (unlock: post-game Will Roll TN12). Counts as a Wand of Power (3); +2 Casting Roll for Draining Word/Power Word; only the wand's power (not the caster's own Health) can empower those spells.

name: Wraith Bow
effect: Artefact (unlock: post-game Will Roll TN16). +1 damage bow; once/game, fire through terrain (target gets +1 Fight as intervening terrain); risk of a Curse effect (Casting Roll 14) on a failed Will Roll after use.

name: Eyes of Eternity
effect: Once ever, re-roll a Dead result on the Survival Table (second roll is final). Sells for 500gc.

name: Eyes of Runic Light
effect: +2 to any attempt to cast Write Scroll. Sells for 250gc.

name: The Armour of Redwar
effect: Ancient magic mail; +1 Move and +1 Fight on combat rolls made against shooting attacks.

name: The Betrayer's Blade
effect: Wizards only; +2 Fight. In multi-figure combats where the wielder is attacker or declared target, supporting figures grant only +1 each instead of +2.

name: The Blade of Barael
effect: Hand-and-a-half sword, wizards/apprentices only (no dagger or shield alongside it); +1 Fight, +2 damage. The bearer can never be targeted by an attack or spell from beyond 12" (friendly or enemy), and is immune to Glow (though Cordial of Clearsight still works normally against them). A natural 20 in melee lets the bearer immediately take another action (needn't be a move).

name: The Boon of Sargosh
effect: Counts as a Staff of Casting, except the wielder chooses which spell it benefits instead of rolling randomly.
